name: spicy-regs-mcp-container
description: Cloudflare Containers deploy for the Spicy Regs MCP server

scripts.check: npm run configure && wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy: npm run configure && wrangler deploy --tag "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" --message "spicy-regs $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)$(git diff --quiet HEAD || echo ' +uncommitted')"
